eligibility.elig.pmfme.activity: Applicant should be involved in an eligible micro food processing activity.
eligibility.elig.pmfme.subsidy: Individual micro food processing units may receive credit-linked capital subsidy of 35% of eligible project cost, subject to a maximum of Rs.10 lakh per unit.
eligibility.elig.pmfme.contribution: Beneficiary contribution should be at least 10% of the project cost.
eligibility.elig.pmegp.guidelines: The applicant must satisfy the eligibility conditions specified in the current PMEGP guidelines.
eligibility.elig.pmegp.maxManufacturing: Maximum project cost for manufacturing units is Rs.50 lakh.
eligibility.elig.pmegp.maxService: Maximum project cost for service/trading units is Rs.20 lakh.
eligibility.elig.pmegp.financing: Bank financing and beneficiary contribution are subject to the applicable PMEGP guidelines.
eligibility.elig.pmmy.activity: Loans are intended for eligible non-agricultural income-generating micro enterprise activities, including specified allied agricultural activities.
eligibility.elig.pmmy.shishu: Shishu loans are up to Rs.50,000.
eligibility.elig.pmmy.kishore: Kishore loans are above Rs.50,000 and up to Rs.5 lakh.
eligibility.elig.pmmy.tarun: Tarun loans are above Rs.5 lakh and up to Rs.10 lakh.
eligibility.elig.pmmy.tarunPlus: Tarun Plus loans are above Rs.10 lakh and up to Rs.20 lakh for entrepreneurs who have successfully repaid a previous Tarun-category loan.
eligibility.elig.common.traditionalTrade: The applicant must work in a traditional trade using hand tools.
eligibility.elig.pmvishwakarma.trades: The applicant must work in one of the 18 trades covered by the scheme, such as tailoring, pottery, blacksmithy, carpentry, hair cutting, goldsmithy, basket weaving or cobbling.
eligibility.elig.pmvishwakarma.toolkit: A toolkit incentive of Rs.15,000 is available after basic skill training.
eligibility.elig.pmvishwakarma.loan: Collateral-free credit of up to Rs.1 lakh in the first tranche and up to Rs.2 lakh in the second, at 5% interest.
eligibility.elig.common.age18: The applicant must be at least 18 years old.
eligibility.elig.standupindia.who: The enterprise must be majority owned and controlled by a woman, or by a person from a Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe community.
eligibility.elig.standupindia.amount: The loan size ranges from Rs.10 lakh to Rs.1 crore.
eligibility.elig.common.newUnit: The unit must be new, not an existing or transferred unit.
eligibility.elig.standupindia.agriAllied: Activities allied to agriculture, such as dairy, poultry and food processing, are covered; crop cultivation on its own is not.
eligibility.elig.nlm.activities: Covers poultry, sheep and goat rearing, piggery, and feed and fodder units.
eligibility.elig.nlm.subsidy: Up to 50% of the project cost is given as a subsidy that is not repaid, subject to a ceiling of Rs.50 lakh.
eligibility.elig.nlm.training: Relevant training or experience in the activity, and land for the unit, are required.
eligibility.elig.common.bankApproval: Final sanction rests with the financing bank.
eligibility.elig.ahidf.purpose: Covers milk chilling and dairy product units, meat processing units, and animal feed plants.
eligibility.elig.ahidf.subvention: An interest subvention of 3% is available for up to eight years.
eligibility.elig.common.ownContribution10: The applicant must contribute at least 10% of the project cost.
eligibility.elig.aif.purpose: Covers post-harvest work such as storage, cold rooms, grading and packing houses, and primary processing units.
eligibility.elig.aif.subvention: Interest subvention of 3% applies on a loan of up to Rs.2 crore, for up to seven years.
eligibility.elig.aif.who: Farmers, self-help groups, farmer producer organisations and micro enterprises may apply.
eligibility.elig.kcc.who: Available to land-owning farmers, tenant farmers, share-croppers and joint liability groups.
eligibility.elig.kcc.rate: Interest is 7% on credit up to Rs.3 lakh, reduced to 4% on timely repayment.
eligibility.elig.kcc.animal: Animal husbandry and fisheries are covered up to Rs.2 lakh.
eligibility.elig.common.age21to40: The applicant must generally be between 21 and 40 years of age.
eligibility.elig.common.class8: The applicant must have passed at least class 8, or hold a recognised skill training certificate.
eligibility.elig.myuva.amount: Project cost of up to Rs.5 lakh is financed, with no interest payable by the beneficiary for the stated period.
eligibility.elig.common.residentState: The applicant must be a resident of the state.
eligibility.elig.vssy.trades: Covers traditional trades such as tailoring, pottery, blacksmithy, carpentry, hair cutting and shoe making.
eligibility.elig.common.freeOfCost: No fee is charged for this assistance.
eligibility.elig.common.age18to45: The applicant must generally be between 18 and 45 years of age.
eligibility.elig.cmegp.limits: Project cost may go up to Rs.50 lakh for manufacturing and Rs.10 lakh for service activities.
eligibility.elig.cmegp.subsidy: A subsidy of 15% to 35% of project cost applies, depending on the applicant category and the location of the unit.
eligibility.elig.needs.who: The applicant must be at least 21 years old and hold a degree, diploma or ITI qualification.
eligibility.elig.needs.subsidy: A capital subsidy of 25% of the project cost applies, on project cost of up to Rs.75 lakh.
eligibility.elig.common.trainingIncluded: Training forms part of the scheme.
eligibility.elig.ess.who: Open to micro and small manufacturing units registered in Kerala.
eligibility.elig.ess.rate: Assistance ranges from 15% to 45% of eligible investment, with the higher rates for women, young entrepreneurs, and applicants from Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe communities.
eligibility.elig.ess.stage: Part of the assistance may be claimed before commencement and the balance after the unit starts production.
eligibility.elig.bcc.amount: Project cost of up to Rs.5 lakh is covered, and the state provides the credit guarantee.
eligibility.elig.bcc.subsidy: A subsidy of 10% of the project cost is provided and is not repaid.
eligibility.elig.udyogini.amount: Loans of up to Rs.3 lakh are available for the listed categories of business.
eligibility.elig.udyogini.subsidy: A subsidy of 30% of the loan, up to Rs.90,000, applies for applicants from Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe and other specified categories.
eligibility.elig.udyogini.income: A family income ceiling applies, except for widows and women with a disability.
eligibility.elig.unnati.where: The unit must be located in one of the eight North Eastern states.
eligibility.elig.unnati.support: Capital investment incentive is provided towards plant, machinery and building, at a higher rate in the more remote districts.
eligibility.elig.unnati.register: Registration on the scheme portal is required before commencing the investment.
eligibility.elig.vvp.where: Only villages in the border blocks notified under the programme are covered.
eligibility.elig.vvp.what: Support is directed at home-stays and rural tourism, dairy and animal husbandry, craft, and small local enterprise.
eligibility.elig.common.askLocalOffice: Rates and conditions vary by location, so confirm them at the local office.
eligibility.elig.common.anyoneInArea: Anyone carrying on or planning work in the area may approach the office.
eligibility.elig.dic.what: The office handles Udyam registration, forwards applications under state and central schemes, and arranges entrepreneurship training.
eligibility.elig.common.ruralArea: The applicant must be from a rural area of the district.
eligibility.elig.rseti.free: Training, boarding and lodging are provided at no cost to the trainee.
eligibility.elig.rseti.followUp: After training the institute assists with the loan application and follows up for about two years.
eligibility.elig.common.farmerOrLabourer: Farmers, farm labourers and farm groups of the area are eligible.
eligibility.elig.kvk.what: Short courses are run on animal husbandry, beekeeping, mushroom cultivation, food processing and seed production.
eligibility.elig.odop.product: Your activity must be the product notified for your own district - ask your District Industries Centre which one it is.
eligibility.elig.odop.toolkit: Trained artisans receive a toolkit and may take part in state and national fairs.
eligibility.elig.odop.margin: A loan with margin money assistance is available under the ODOP financing component.
eligibility.elig.tehsil.what: The office issues income, caste, residence and land-related certificates.
eligibility.elig.tehsil.time: A certificate is usually issued within a few working days once the papers are complete.
eligibility.elig.tehsil.online: Many states also accept these applications online or through a Common Service Centre.
eligibility.elig.subdivAgri.what: A share of the cost of seeds, hand tools, small farm machinery and micro-irrigation is met by the government.
eligibility.elig.bdo.who: Rural households are covered, in particular women joining a self-help group.
eligibility.elig.bdo.funds: A well-functioning group receives a revolving fund and a community investment fund to on-lend to its members.
eligibility.elig.bdo.lakhpati: The Lakhpati Didi effort supports women members in building annual earnings of a lakh or more.
eligibility.elig.common.shgMember: Membership of a self-help group is required.
eligibility.elig.blbc.how: Ask your block office or bank branch for the date of the next meeting and how to place your case before it.
eligibility.elig.blbc.meets: The committee meets once a quarter and reviews the block credit plan and pending applications.
eligibility.elig.atma.what: Field demonstrations, farmer field schools, and sponsored study visits within and outside the district are provided.
eligibility.elig.atma.friend: Each village has a designated farmer friend who can be approached first.
eligibility.elig.gp.what: The Panchayat issues a no-objection letter and trade permission, and verifies your papers for other schemes.
eligibility.elig.gp.plan: Ask for your requirement to be included in the yearly Gram Panchayat Development Plan at the Gram Sabha meeting.
eligibility.elig.csc.what: The operator can register you under PM Vishwakarma, MUDRA and other schemes, and print the acknowledgement.
eligibility.elig.common.smallFee: A small fixed service charge applies for each service.
eligibility.elig.common.aadhaarBank: An Aadhaar card and a bank account in the applicant's own name are required.
eligibility.elig.common.urbanArea: The activity must be in a town or city area covered by an urban local body.
eligibility.elig.svanidhi.who: The vendor must have been covered by the local body vending survey, or hold a certificate of vending or a letter of recommendation.
eligibility.elig.svanidhi.ladder: The first loan is Rs.10,000; on timely repayment the next is Rs.20,000, and then Rs.50,000.
eligibility.elig.svanidhi.cashback: Digital transactions earn cash back, and timely repayment earns a 7% interest subsidy.
eligibility.elig.common.noCollateral: No collateral has to be pledged.
